messages:
emily: Hi all  first day! Using Pop!_OS (Linux) and trying to bootstrap dev: asdf for node/python, fish shell, and Docker Compose for local services. Problems: 1) asdf shims not picked up in fish; 2) docker-compose service on 3000 not reachable from host (I use systemd-resolved). Any tips?

nate: welcome! For fish, you need the asdf fish completions and init. Add to ~/.config/fish/conf.d/asdf.fish: `source ~/.asdf/asdf.fish; source ~/.asdf/completions/asdf.fish`. Also ensure `~/.asdf/shims` is in PATH: `set -U fish_user_paths $HOME/.asdf/shims $fish_user_paths`.

emily: added that but `node -v` still shows system node. I installed node via apt ages ago. How to prefer asdf?

ana: remove or move the apt node path earlier in PATH. In fish you can check `echo $PATH` and run `type -a node` to see order. We usually uninstall the distro node package: `sudo apt remove nodejs` so asdf shims win.

emily: cool will remove. Docker issue: compose brings up web:3000 but I can't curl localhost:3000 from host, only inside container.

nate: check your compose file port mapping: `ports: - "3000:3000"` and confirm the app binds to 0.0.0.0 not 127.0.0.1. For systemd-resolved sometimes DNS weirdness, but binding is the usual culprit.

emily: yep app bound to 127.0.0.1, changed to 0.0.0.0 and works. thanks!

ci-bot: Reminder: complete "dev env configured" onboarding step: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/12345

emily: done, added SSH key to GitHub and will uninstall system node. Appreciate the help :slightly_smiling_face:
